camel_example: aliyun cms PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule --region cn-hangzhou --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Name hostName --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Value nginx --GroupRules.1.Category ecs --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Function contains --IsAsync false --GroupRules.1.FilterRelation and --GroupId 123456
description_en: Creates or modifies an alert rule to dynamically add instances that meet the rule to an application group
description_zh: 调用PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule接口创建或修改按照实例名称动态匹配的应用分组，满足匹配规则的所有实例自动添加到该应用分组中
name: PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule

parameters.description_en: The ID of the application group.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

element_fields.description_en:
The logical operator used between conditional expressions in the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

- and: The instances that meet all the conditional expressions are automatically added to the application group.

- or: The instances that meet one of the conditional expressions are automatically added to the application group.
element_fields.description_zh:
动态报警规则的组合条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

- and：满足所有报警规则的实例才会自动添加到应用分组。

- or：满足任意报警规则的实例都会自动添加到应用分组。

The name of the field based on which instances are filtered. Valid values of N: 1 to 3.
